visualQa.observation: The right friend holds a fully open blue umbrella overhead, connected to its hand by a continuous shaft with a hooked handle below. The closed umbrella is gone. Both characters retain two arms, their expressions and positions, and the seedling and rainy beige-paper watercolor scene remain. Generative rendering introduces minor texture differences, so preservation is visual and semantic rather than pixel-identical.
